indicators.flag: Client negotiates a purchase for the market value or above, but requests that a lower value be recorded on documents, and pays the difference “under the table”.
indicators.red_flag: Recorded price under-stated vs paid market value (under-the-table top-up)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D18 (Real-estate / property & valuation data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Loan/mortgage amount is above the market value of the property/real estate.
indicators.red_flag: Loan/mortgage above property market value (over-valuation lending)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D18 (Real-estate / property & valuation data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client purchases property in someone else’s name such as an associate, nominee, from a company, corporation, trust or a relative (other than a spouse).
indicators.red_flag: Title held by nominee / associate / corporate-trust proxy
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.

build_logic.source: corporate registry + KYC beneficial-ownership records + entity-resolution graph

indicators.red_flag: Buyer with no verifiable contact / web footprint (shell-thin presence)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Client refuses to provide own name on documents, or uses different names on offers to purchase, closing documents and deposit receipts.
indicators.red_flag: Name-withholding / mismatched names across deal documents
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client insists on providing signature on documents by fax only.
indicators.red_flag: Signature furnished by fax-only to avoid in-person verification
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client uses a post office box or general delivery address where other options are available.
indicators.red_flag: PO-box / general-delivery address despite alternatives
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C13 (Account-opening / KYC risk profiling).

indicators.flag: Client buys back a property that he or she recently sold.
indicators.red_flag: Buy-back of recently-sold property (circular flip)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D18 (Real-estate / property & valuation data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Successive buying and selling transactions of the same real estate.
indicators.red_flag: Rapid successive buy-sell of same property (flipping)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D18 (Real-estate / property & valuation data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client shows strong interest in quickly completing the transaction without good cause, or without interest in property characteristics, price negotiations, risks, commissions or other related details, or may offer unusually high bids relative to current value/industry standard.
indicators.red_flag: Rushed close with no due-diligence interest / over-market bid
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D18.

indicators.flag: Clients show considerable interest in transactions relating to buildings in particular areas without caring about the price they have to pay.
indicators.red_flag: Price-indifferent targeting of specific-area properties
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D18.

indicators.flag: Accelerated repayment of loan/mortgage shortly after deal is completed even if penalties are incurred.
indicators.red_flag: Penalty-disregarding early mortgage payoff post-close
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D1 (Core transaction monitoring (deposit/account ledger)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag high-value-asset financing or purchase activity with laundering markers â purchase price diverging from appraisal, rapid flipping, anomalous loan-to-value or repayment structures, or substantial cash funding â escalating when value inflation pairs with structured repayments.
build_logic.window: per asset transaction + rolling 180-day holding window
build_logic.source: lending/mortgage system + asset appraisal + funding-source ledger
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML investigations gate

indicators.flag: The conditions in the loan agreement are unusual (for example, no collateral was required) or the complex nature of the loan scheme could not be justified.

indicators.flag: Invoices for real or phantom large remodelling or renovations are paid with cash.
indicators.red_flag: Cash-paid large/phantom renovation invoices (placement channel)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Buyer of income-generating property shows no interest in generating profit by filling-in vacancies or by adjusting rent or lease value based on market value.
indicators.red_flag: Income-property owner indifferent to yield (profit-irrelevant hold)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D18 (Real-estate / property & valuation data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Incoming payments from abroad possibly linked to a trust account, followed immediately by wire transfers abroad without a logical reason.
indicators.red_flag: Inbound foreign funds via trust account immediately wired back out (pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Multiple transactions involving payments in cash or in negotiable instruments (for example, bank drafts) which do not state the true payer and where the accumulated amount is considered to be significant in relation to the total amount of the transaction.
indicators.red_flag: Multiple cash / payer-anonymous draft payments aggregating to significant share
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.flag: Foreign buyer, either an individual or company, or source of funds are from a jurisdiction with strict bank secrecy laws, weak anti-money laundering regimes, or with a high level of political corruption
indicators.red_flag: Buyer / source-of-funds from secrecy / weak-AML / high-corruption jurisdiction
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Foreign buyer, either an individual or company, especially if on a watch list, whose only connection to Canada is the real estate transaction.
indicators.red_flag: Watchlisted foreign buyer whose sole Canada nexus is the purchase
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).

indicators.flag: Client purchases personal use property through his or her company when this type of transaction is inconsistent with the client’s ordinary business practice.
indicators.red_flag: Personal-use property bought via company against normal business pattern
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.
